name: UE4-NeRF
definition: A neural rendering system for real-time rendering of large-scale scenes that partitions scenes into sub-NeRFs, represents them using textured polygonal meshes initialized from regular octahedra, and integrates with the Unreal Engine 4 (UE4) rasterization pipeline.
summary: UE4-NeRF is a real-time neural rendering system that integrates NeRF with Unreal Engine 4, using textured polygonal meshes and LOD hierarchies to render large-scale 3D scenes.
